attempting entanglement many more times per round than the other two protocols.

The latching process in MidpointSource is attempted at a fast repetition rate having cycle time tclock that
is limited only by the maximum of three time quantities: (a)the length of time bin in which one attempts to
generate an entangled-photon pair, (b)the recovery time for BSA detectors, and (c)the total time to reset a
memory qubit and emit a photon. This clock cycle is independent of the signaling time across the channel, so the
average time to latch a qubit can be much less than tlink.
